$comment: Source of truth for the 72 canonical top-level directories. `node tools/structure.mjs --write` regenerates every README.md; `--check` (run by tools/verify.mjs) fails if a README is stale, a referenced path is missing, a register domain is unassigned or assigned twice, or a canonical directory is empty apart from its README. Implementation stays where the build tools expect it (crates/, web/); these directories own it and point to it.

directories.title: Governance
directories.purpose: Architecture, ADRs, standards, product decisions and ownership.
directories.gaps: Release artifacts are not yet signed.

directories.title: Product management
directories.purpose: Requirements, roadmap, feature register and acceptance criteria.

directories.title: Domain model
directories.purpose: Agricultural ontology, domain types, invariants and terminology.
directories.gaps: No ontology crosswalks (e.g. AGROVOC) are loaded.

directories.title: Angular application
directories.purpose: Angular app, routes, layouts, state and accessibility.
directories.gaps: No browser end-to-end tests.

directories.title: Design system
directories.purpose: Tokens, themes, components, icons and visual standards.
directories.gaps: Design tokens live in one stylesheet; there is no component library.

directories.title: Frontend feature screens
directories.purpose: Catalogue, analytics, GIS, research and administration screens.
directories.gaps: No GIS map, research workbench or administration screens.

directories.title: Frontend shared code
directories.purpose: Shared components, pipes, directives, guards and utilities.

directories.title: API clients
directories.purpose: Generated clients, DTOs, transport and API error handling.
directories.gaps: The client is hand-written against 10_backend_api/openapi.v1.yaml, not generated from it.

directories.title: Rust workspace
directories.purpose: Rust application workspace and shared crates.

directories.title: HTTP API
directories.purpose: HTTP routing, handlers and request/response contracts.
directories.gaps: No WebSocket or server-sent-events channel.

directories.title: Application services
directories.purpose: Use cases, orchestration and application services.

directories.title: Pure domain logic
directories.purpose: Pure domain logic, domain events and value objects.

directories.title: Ports
directories.purpose: Ports, traits, repository contracts and service interfaces.
directories.gaps: No repository trait separates the engine from its embedded storage yet.

directories.title: Adapters
directories.purpose: Database, object storage and external service adapters.
directories.gaps: Only the embedded journal adapter exists; PostgreSQL, PostGIS, object storage and external-service adapters are not implemented.

directories.title: Authentication
directories.purpose: Identity integration, authentication and sessions.
directories.gaps: Static hashed bearer tokens only; OIDC/SAML/passkeys/MFA need an identity provider (01_governance/adr/0004-authentication.md).

directories.title: Authorization
directories.purpose: RBAC, ABAC, policy evaluation and resource scopes.
directories.gaps: Role-based only; no attribute-based policies or policy simulation.

directories.title: Tenancy
directories.purpose: Tenant resolution, isolation, quotas and context.
directories.gaps: No quota enforcement beyond per-token rate limits.

directories.title: Configuration
directories.purpose: Typed configuration, validation and feature flags.
directories.gaps: Configuration is CLI flags and environment variables; there are no feature flags.

directories.title: Errors
directories.purpose: Typed errors, error codes and problem details.

directories.title: Observability
directories.purpose: Tracing, metrics, structured logging and correlation.
directories.gaps: No OpenTelemetry trace export; dashboards and alerts have not been loaded into a running Prometheus/Grafana.

directories.title: Jobs
directories.purpose: Job definitions, queue adapters, workers and cancellation.
directories.gaps: No job queue or worker; workflows run synchronously.

directories.title: Workflows
directories.purpose: Workflow graph, state machine, retries and checkpoints.
directories.gaps: No retries or checkpoints; runs are single-pass and synchronous.

directories.title: Events and audit
directories.purpose: Event envelopes, schema registry, consumers and outbox.
directories.gaps: The hash-chained audit log is the only event stream; there are no external consumers.

directories.title: Notifications
directories.purpose: Templates, subscriptions and delivery adapters.
directories.gaps: Outbox only; email and webhook delivery are not implemented.

directories.title: Data catalogue
directories.purpose: Catalogue service, metadata schema and discovery.

directories.title: Ingestion
directories.purpose: Connectors, parsers, staging and import jobs.

directories.title: Data quality
directories.purpose: Quality rules, profiling and validation reports.

directories.title: Transformation
directories.purpose: Transformation registry, execution and lineage.
directories.gaps: Transformations are field mappings and schema migrations; there are no joins or aggregations over records.

directories.title: Lineage
directories.purpose: Lineage graph, provenance records and query API.

directories.title: Versioning
